principle: A PDD rule is a contract between entities. The application computes applicable binary relations from entities, facts and control conditions.

participant.description: Actor whose movement is evaluated from its current perspective.

road.description: Road or road segment that provides context and may impose requirements.

intersection.description: Spatial context in which participant movements may conflict.

control.description: Object or actor that determines the applicable movement regime.

facts.description: Observed or constructed relations between entities before rule evaluation.

control_resolution.description: Resolve the applicable movement regime by the strongest active control source.
